paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst, AI Transformation role at Twitch. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What interests me is the idea of this role as a bridge between FP&A and AI tools. You're asking finance to rethink how the work gets done, while still owning the numbers the CFO relies on.

At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses on capital allocation that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget changes. I also worked on AI powered dashboards and reporting automation, where I owned the mapping, QA and problem identification rather than the coding. At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked on budget allocation across marketing channels. I built models to evaluate how to deploy $10M and benchmarked past allocations, which identified 30% in efficiency gains.

That maps to the forecasting, ROI analysis and executive reporting here. On the automation side, knowing where a process breaks and how to check the output is the part I've done most. Building agentic workflows would be a step up for me, and I'd want to work closely with your tech teams on it. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
